title: Exploratory Data Analysis with an Agent
titleZh: 用 Agent 做探索性数据分析
summary: A challenge course — point your agent at a messy shop export and produce a verified EDA summary whose numbers are checked against ground truth.
summaryZh: 一门挑战课程——让你的 Agent 处理一份脏的商店导出数据，产出一份经过真值校验的 EDA 摘要。
outcome: A pandas script that cleans a 142-row messy export (duplicates, bad amounts, bad dates) and writes results.json verified against ground truth — the load → clean → summarize pipeline you can port to your own data.
outcomeZh: 一个 pandas 脚本：清洗 142 行脏导出（重复、坏金额、坏日期），产出经真值校验的 results.json——一套可以迁移到你自己数据上的加载 → 清洗 → 统计流水线。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
uv or pip to install the pinned pandas dependency
Any coding agent; no pandas experience required
First non-stdlib course — installing the environment is part of the challenge
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
用 uv 或 pip 安装锁定的 pandas 依赖
任一编码 Agent；不要求 pandas 经验
第一门非标准库课程——装环境本身就是挑战的一部分

lessons.title: What messy data looks like
lessons.objective: Profile the CSV before touching code: total rows, exact duplicates, unparseable amounts and dates.
lessons.objectiveZh: 写代码前先给 CSV 做画像：总行数、完全重复行、不可解析的金额与日期。

lessons.title: Define the answer first
lessons.objective: Write down the expected results.json shape — keys, types, rounding — before letting the agent generate code.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在让 Agent 生成代码之前，先写下期望的 results.json 结构——键、类型、舍入规则。

lessons.title: Clean and summarize
lessons.objective: Implement the contract in starter/eda.py: load, clean with counted removals, summarize, write results.json.
lessons.objectiveZh: 在 starter/eda.py 里实现契约：加载、按计数清洗、统计、写出 results.json。

lessons.title: Check against ground truth
lessons.objective: The suite asserts exact numbers — 142 in, 137 clean, total revenue 33347.89 — plausible-but-different numbers are a fail.
lessons.objectiveZh: 套件断言精确数字——输入 142 行、清洗后 137、总收入 33347.89——看似合理但不同的数字就是失败。

lessons.title: Run it on your own data
lessons.objective: Port the pipeline to a real export you own and name one assumption that broke.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把流水线迁移到你真实的一份导出上，并说出一条不成立的假设。

scenarios.title: Messy shop export
scenarios.blurb: 142 rows with exact duplicates, unparseable amounts, and a bad date.
scenarios.blurbZh: 142 行，含完全重复、不可解析金额与一条坏日期。

verification.method: Twelve-test contract suite asserting exact numbers against ground truth. The starter must reproduce the unfinished state; the reviewed solution passes 12/12.
verification.methodZh: 十二个测试的契约套件，按真值断言精确数字。starter 必须复现未完成状态；已审核实现 12/12 通过。

levelZh: 新手向；第一门 pandas 课程
